background: Principality Building Society is the largest building society in Wales, a mutual funded by retail savings from its branch network and lending on residential mortgages, with a commercial and development lending arm.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the society, BBB+ on average, both on a stable outlook, the last upgrade a one-notch move by one of the three on 3 Jul 2023; a further action on its long-term rating by one of the three on 21 Oct 2026 left both outlooks stable. CET1 of 18.7% is in the top quarter of UK building societies, but it has fallen 15.3 points since 31 Dec 2021 and LCR has fallen 126 points to 168%, now in the bottom quarter. Leverage of 5.3% and NSFR of 144% are just below the peer median, and the figures run only to 31 Dec 2025.
